note: Holdout MAPE uses Python inference (S20 ExtraTrees, S21 LightGBM Layers 1–3). Browser S21 additionally applies Layer-4 PAV for grade ordering; that projection is measured in compare-s20-s21.mjs monotonicity sweeps.

s20.name: S20 — Specialty cut + monotonic large-carat tail
s20.description: S19 residual model plus explicit Chinese specialty-cut features and a monotonic parametric 5ct+ tail, 160 trees, depth=20

s21.name: S21 — Monotone grade model (LightGBM + isotonic lookup + rank features)
s21.description: Layer-1 isotonic lookup PAV + Layer-2 Clarity_Rank/Color_Rank ordinal features + Layer-3 LightGBM monotone_constraints (400 trees, num_leaves=63, lr=0.04) + Layer-4 PAV projection at browser inference

mapeMethodology.perStonePctOff: For each holdout stone: pctOff = 100 × |predicted − actual| / actual. Uses SaleDollorPrice (total stone), selected-spec inference view.
mapeMethodology.bucketMape: Within a bucket (e.g. carat_bucket '1.00-1.49'): MAPE = arithmetic mean of pctOff over stones in that bucket only. Each stone counts equally — not dollar-weighted within the bucket.
mapeMethodology.overallMape: MAPE over all 792 holdout stones = mean(pctOff). Mathematically equals volume-weighted mean of bucket MAPEs when buckets partition the set, but does NOT match catalog-weighted MAPE (see below).
mapeMethodology.wmape: 100 × Σ|error| / Σ(actual) — dollar-weighted; large stones pull more.
mapeMethodology.catalogWeightedMape: Σ (training_stock_count_segment × pctOff) / Σ training_stock_count_segment for stones in that segment. Reflects how much of the sheet is round 1–2 ct vs 5 ct+, so headline MAPE is not dominated by rare holdout buckets.
mapeMethodology.holdoutCaveat: Holdout is one stone per (Shape × carat_bucket × Color × Clarity × Cut) — balanced for training, not proportional to sales volume. Raw overall MAPE can look acceptable because 1–2 ct round is accurate while large-carat buckets are worse but fewer holdout rows.

catalogWeighting.note: Each holdout stone is weighted by how many priced rows exist on the full StarGem sheet in the same segment. This raises MAPE toward high-volume buckets (often 1–1.49 ct round) but large-dollar 5 ct+ rows still move WMAPE. Compare prioritySegments.round_1_00_to_2_00ct for the product focus in isolation.
